summary: AlembicPlugin P4 consumer completed in commit 3ed999f. The production path still defaults disabled with keyword fallback; when enabled and a mocked pulled qwen3-embedding model is available, VectorModule injects the Core Ollama provider and VectorService.getAvailability() reports embed-provider-ready. Submit freshness output now has regression coverage proving ready semantic indexing surfaces without embed-provider-missing vector degradation. No Core changes and no non-Ollama provider were introduced.
